description.value:
A single breath, held on your behalf, since before you were born of it.

Gift — Once per day, when you'd be reduced to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP instead and the killing wound seals shut in front of everyone watching, on a single held breath. Tithe — The breath isn't free: for the rest of that scene you cannot raise your voice above a whisper — shouting, casting a verbal component loudly, or bellowing a command simply doesn't happen.

cinderfall.incomplete: "When you'd be reduced to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP instead" (once per day) has no confirmed rule-element hook: pf2e's dying/unconsciousness-at-0-HP sequence is a built-in engine flow, and no rule element overriding 'you don't fall unconscious, you drop to 1 HP instead' was found in pf2e-source.
